timeline._doc: Single source of truth for the first-launch intro. Times in seconds; positions normalized to the window (0..1). build-assets.mjs bakes this into apps/dove/src/intro/data.rs and data.json; make-sound.mjs reads it for cue timing.

geometry._doc: Dove facing +x, y down, ~110 units long. Rings are [start, [c1x,c1y,c2x,c2y,x,y]...]. Wing poses share structure and are blended by wing value w (1 up, 0 glide, -1 down).
